description: HRM:s dagvattenavloppsområde is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). The data contains information on the extent of HSY's stormwater drainage area at the property level. The ​Hulevesi sewerage area is based on Section 17a of the Water Supply Act. Coverage: Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). The portal shows the English title as "HSY’s stormwater sewerage area" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). Its keywords include stormwater, avlopp, sewer systems, hulevesi, liittymisvelvollisuus, hulevesiviemärit. The listing shows 6 download or service links in TAB, WMS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
